entities.name: Zaliki
entities.description: A Nacatl leonin shaman of Ajani's tribe on Alara, manipulated into helping summon undead horrors from Grixis.

entities.name: Ajani
entities.description: Leonin planeswalker whose spark was triggered by his brother's death.

entities.name: Jazal Goldmane
entities.description: Ajani's brother, the kha, killed by the undead horrors.

entities.name: Grixis
entities.description: Shard of Alara from which undead horrors were summoned.

entities.name: Jund
entities.description: Shard of Alara Ajani planeswalked to.

entities.name: Nacatl
entities.description: The leonin tribe of Zaliki and Ajani.

events.summary: Zaliki slinks off while the kha speaks, and Ajani follows her to Jazal's den.
events.quote: Zaliki slinked off into the night

events.summary: Ajani finds mystic symbols on the den walls, one depicting a one-eyed Leonin, but leaves it be.
events.quote: Ajani discovered that the walls of Jazal's den were covered in mystic symbols

events.summary: Undead horrors from Grixis, summoned with Zaliki's manipulated help, appear while the pride sleeps.
events.quote: Zaliki had been manipulated into assisting the summoning of undead horrors

events.summary: The horrors kill Jazal, triggering Ajani's spark and sending him to Jund.
events.quote: These horrors killed Ajani's brother Jazal, triggering Ajani's planeswalker spark

relations.quote: Zaliki was the shaman of Ajani
